name: jjc-claude-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills and hooks shared across projects and with contributors.

plugins.name: intent-layer
plugins.description: Builds and maintains CLAUDE.md intent-layer nodes — an interview that establishes a layer from scratch, doctrine for authoring and pruning it, and a hook that speaks when code changes without its node or a session shows a recurring pitfall.

plugins.name: ruff-gate
plugins.description: A ruff gate that travels between repos — lints the Python file it just wrote, then holds the turn open until everything the turn touched is clean. Silent in any repo without a ruff config, so it costs nothing where it isn't wanted.

plugins.name: permission-log
plugins.description: Logs every permission prompt as one local JSON line — tool, session, directory, and a redacted summary — so you can count which calls keep asking and tune your allowlist. Observes only: it never answers, delays, or denies the prompt.

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Test-driven development calibrated to risk — pick a rigor tier before writing a test, then run the red-green-refactor loop at that tier: naming the break a test catches, deriving expected values independently, mocking only the slow or external layer, and a pre-done mutation check.

plugins.name: commit-gate
plugins.description: Refuses `git commit` until your latest prompt approves one ("go", "commit it"), and asks again once work resumes after a commit. Stops the agent committing past a review pause.

plugins.name: attention-chime
plugins.description: A sound when Claude needs a decision from you, another when the work you asked for is done, and a purr on auto-compact. Silent for subagents, stops a gate blocked, idle reminders and turns nobody asked for.
